dimensions.label: Feature Delivery
dimensions.blurb: New capability shipped, weighted by how central the touched code is.
dimensions.formula: FD(e) = Σ W(pr) over merged feat PRs where DRI(pr)=e

dimensions.label: Reliability
dimensions.blurb: Fix and perf work delivered, scaled by whether their own features stay fixed.
dimensions.formula: REL(e) = Σ W(pr) over fix+perf PRs × Q(e)

dimensions.label: Blast Radius
dimensions.blurb: How much of the load-bearing, widely-shared code they operate across.
dimensions.formula: BLAST(e) = Σ log₂(1+κ(d)) over dirs d they touch with κ(d) > median

dimensions.label: Review Leverage
dimensions.blurb: How many different engineers they unblock, and how fast.

dimensions.label: Review Depth
dimensions.blurb: Whether their reviews actually changed the code.

dimensions.label: Ownership & Bus Factor
dimensions.blurb: Whether they hold a critical area. Two-signed: fewer defects, more continuity risk.
dimensions.formula: OWN(e) = Σ share(e,d) × κ(d) for share(e,d) ≥ 0.25

dimensions.label: Agent Leverage
dimensions.blurb: Volume shipped through agents that actually held up.
dimensions.formula: AGT(e) = Q(e) × Σ W₀(pr) over agent-involved PRs
